newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UIC completes acquisition of Yongnam.
newsitem.headline: UIC completes acquisition of Yongnam.

text.p: Property company United Industrial Corp (UIC) said on Wednesday its subsidiary had bought 20 percent of the shares in Yongnam Holdings Pte Ltd.

It said in a statement Alshine Pte Ltd bought 5.12 million Yongnam ordinary shares for Singapore $1.00 each at a total cost of Singapore S$11 million, and that purchase made Yongnam an associate company of UIC.
UIC said the acquisition was not expected to have any significant effect on its net tangible asset or earnings per share for the financial year ending December 31, 1997.
Its share price struck a new low of S$1.06 on Wednesday with 5.7 million shares changing hands.
Selling was sparked by unexciting growth prospects and fears of new government curbs on property speculation, analysts said.
